source: Fragment public pages via TG Gifts (tggifts.com)
method: Each point is the floor recorded at the radar's first reading of that UTC day (the day's open); it is not updated later that day, so today's point can be older than the live floor. Live floor: https://tggifts.com/floors. Price kind: b = cheapest buy-now listing, t = cheapest timed sale.

timed_sale_collections.note: Collections listed on Fragment only as timed sales (buy-now with a sale timer). Shown separately: they have no buy-now floor and fewer than the 15 recent sales the TG Gifts Index requires, and the published index history has no rows for them, so they are not in `days` or in the index.

price_kind_note: b = cheapest buy-now listing (a floor), t = cheapest timed sale (no buy-now floor in that collection that day)
